# notcfo

> notcfo is an agentic forecasting and opinion practice covering macro conditions, capital markets, crypto markets, geopolitics, and frontier AI. Built and maintained by Shota Zhvania (20+ years in debt capital markets). The scheduled machine half is a Grok swarm: one live search, five independent ballots, and a median computed in code. Every forecast publishes its resolution criteria before the outcome is known, and every resolved call stays in a permanent public track record — nothing is removed if it turns out wrong.

## Mechanism

Two forecasting systems share one foundation.

- **Sensing** — an autonomous web search gathers current information per domain, organized into ten categories (official data, market pricing, deal flow, expert commentary, social discourse, historical precedent, practitioner accounts, cross-domain analogy, peer benchmarking, academic literature) rather than one vague summary.
- **The Oracle** (on-demand) — [oracle.html](https://notcfo.com/oracle.html). Five independent ballots (Analyst, Skeptic, Quant, Historian, Contrarian) forecast with no cross-talk, then the median is computed in the browser. The speaker writes the sentence and cannot move the number. Four horizons every run: 24 hours, 1 week, 1 month, 1 year. A consult uses an xAI key held in that browser tab only. The repository secret is not exposed to the page.
- **The Orchestra** (scheduled) — runs itself once daily. A Scout collects dated figures. An Aggregator sorts them, a Tagger marks relevance to the event, and an Archivist appends them to a series. Six ballots (Analyst, Skeptic, Quant, Historian, Contrarian, Scholar) cannot see each other. The published probability is their median, computed in code, and only when that domain's slot is open. A speaker writes the sentence and cannot change the number. A Chief of Staff then writes the next search order. That order is followed on the next run. It does not edit the code.
- **Resolution** — once a call's horizon passes, a research agent investigates the real outcome against resolution criteria that were written before anyone knew the answer, and drafts a verdict with evidence and sources. A human reviews and approves every resolution before it becomes public; nothing resolves itself.

## Data (machine-readable JSON, no key required)

- [Standing calls](https://notcfo.com/data/calls.json) — the Orchestra's currently active forecasts. Fields: `id`, `domain`, `question`, `horizon` (`24h`/`1w`/`1m`/`1y`), `probability` (0-100), `forecast` (one-line verdict), `resolutionCriteria`, `calledAt` (ISO timestamp).
- [Track record](https://notcfo.com/data/track-record.json) — every resolved call, kept permanently. Same fields as above, plus `resolvedAt`, `outcome` (`yes`/`no`/`partial`), `note` (resolution evidence summary), `sources`.
- [Signal](https://notcfo.com/data/signal.json) — one headline per coverage domain. A figure is published only with `evidence[]`: `value`, `unit`, `observedOn`, `source` (a URL the search tool returned), and `point`. Rows that fail that check are listed in `gaps` and do not move a number. Other fields: `id`, `domain`, `headline`, `summary`, `asOf`.
- [Desk Notes](https://notcfo.com/data/desk-notes.json) — dated, written commentary from the human half, kept as a permanent archive. Fields: `id` (also a URL slug), `date`, `tag`, `title`, `body` (array of paragraphs/points).

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://notcfo.com/) — live Signal and standing calls.
- [Oracle](https://notcfo.com/oracle.html) — on-demand swarm consult.
- [Orchestra](https://notcfo.com/orchestra.html) — the standing book, with criteria.
- [Method](https://notcfo.com/method.html) — how a number is produced.
- [Desk Notes archive](https://notcfo.com/notes.html) — every dated commentary entry ever published, newest first. Individual entries are linkable at `/notes.html#note-{id}`.
- [Desk Notes archive](https://notcfo.com/notes.html) — every dated commentary entry ever published, newest first. Individual entries are linkable at `/notes.html#note-{id}`.
- [About](https://notcfo.com/about.html) — who built this and why, the human/machine division of labor stated plainly, and the same mechanism explained in more depth.

## Coverage domains

Macro Health & Sentiment (US/EU) · Financial & Capital Markets · Crypto Markets · Geopolitics, Policy & Regulatory · Frontier AI & Energy
